title: detect records changed_utc in _fetch_state.csv, so a pack's [source changed] mark can fire on the live kb
goal: factdiff detect writes the state row's changed_utc when a source's verdict is changed, replaced or moved (or the stamp reads the change date from the field detect does write), so the change history in git and a fact's [source changed] mark read it, which today only fetch.py writes (85 of 2610 rows of the public root's state file on 2026-10-12, 0 of 2590 when found), with a test that runs detect on a planted changed page and finds the date in the state row and the mark on a pack line citing it. Found in the SP-tm4wlsve retrospective: ST-ebn65qen's mark compares an anchor's verified_utc with its source's changed_utc and its check passed only on planted state.
notes: Merged from BG-w3p7fqy2 “factdiff.py detect never records changed_utc, so no source of _fetch_state.csv has a recorded change” at the 2026-10-12 draft triage: Its own note names ST-fxz2wrfe as the duplicate; its repro now passes spuriously (85 kb/public rows hold changed_utc, written by fetch.py on first fetch) while factdiff.py still has no changed_utc write. Its goal: factdiff.py detect writes the state row's changed_utc when a source's verdict is changed, replaced or moved, so the change history in git and the source changed mark of a fact read it; the repro exits 0 once a detect run has recorded a change. Its repro: {"run": ["python3", "-c", "import csv, sys; sys.exit(0 if any(r['changed_utc'] for r in csv.DictReader(open('kb/public/_fetch_state.csv', encoding='utf-8'))) else 1)"]} Planned at the 2026-10-12 draft triage (sprint 6 of 19, "Freshness at lookup: revalidation compares the right window and remembers what it checked"): it serves the fitness tests of EP-gzr4mmkm: a lookup's verdict or the benchmark's measurement is wrong until it is fixed. Premise: factdiff detect never writes changed_utc. Run 2026-10-12 on origin/main: factdiff.py holds no changed_utc (grep count 0), kb/public/_fetch_state.csv has 85 of 2610 rows with one, all fetch.py writes, and the check selection collects no test yet: reproduces. The merged BG-w3p7fqy2 repro passes spuriously, so it is not kept. The test name carries detect_writes_changed_utc. Run last: it follows the other items on factdiff.py and test_live_kb.py.
